title: A Multiverse of Good and Bad Controls: Candidate Causal Graphs for Interpreting Model Robustness Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.16618v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model robustness analysis estimates an effect across a multiverse of specifications that pools control sets identifying the declared estimand with sets that condition on mediators or colliders. We propose stating rival assumptions about contested controls as a small set of candidate causal graphs, enumerating the adjustment sets each graph licenses, and reporting robustness metrics conditional on each graph. A finite-mixture identity splits the licensed multiverse's dispersion into within-graph and between-graph components; the between-graph share is a conditional descriptive summary whose reading depends on the candidate set, the weights, and a common estimand. Simulations examine misleading pooled robustness assessments and the limits of the decomposition. translated_title: 好坏控制变量的多元宇宙：用于解释模型稳健性分析的候选因果图
translated_abstract: 模型稳健性分析在多种设定的多元宇宙中估计一个效应，其中将识别所声明估计量的合理控制变量集与以中介变量或碰撞变量为条件的控制变量集混合在一起。我们提出将有争议控制变量的对立假设表述为一小组候选因果图，枚举每个图所许可的调整变量集，并报告以每个图为条件的稳健性指标。一个有限混合恒等式将许可的多元宇宙的离散度分解为图内和图间成分；图间份额是一个条件性描述性摘要，其解读取决于候选图集、权重和共同的估计量。模拟研究检验了误导性的汇总稳健性评估以及该分解方法的局限性。在飓风死亡人数、职业培训和工会工资数据上的应用展示了在所有因果图下都存在的脆弱性、由未经许可的设定导致的不稳定性，以及一种脆弱性…
tldr: 该论文提出将有争议控制变量的对立假设表述为候选因果图集合，并通过有限混合分解将稳健性分析的变异分解为图内和图间成分，从而更严谨地解释模型稳健性分析的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes representing rival assumptions about contested controls as a set of candidate causal graphs and using a finite-mixture decomposition to split robustness analysis dispersion into within-graph and between-graph components, enabling more rigorous interpretation of model robustness analysis.
